steps.action: Place the four curved slopes on top in two rows of two, flanking the central gray plate, with the curves sloping down toward the front and back edges.
watch_for: Curve direction: each slope must slope away from the center toward the outer edge
Leave the central 2x2 studs exposed between the slopes

steps.action: Attach the four curved bricks at the four top corners, with the curved sides facing outward to round off the ends.
watch_for: Curves must face outward at each corner, not inward
Place them on the corner studs, not in the middle of the edge
